architecture: Frozen Lightning protein POC semantics; no post-outcome tuning
failure_rule: No threshold or architecture changes after reveal; failure is recorded as-is.
primary_metrics: Spearman on frozen eligible hidden candidates

protocol.freeze: candidate IDs and scores hashed before hidden-label reveal
protocol.generator: compose mutation components supported by visible observations only
protocol.hidden_set: remaining 30%; labels inaccessible to candidate construction

reason_for_choice: benign fluorescent protein with measured combinatorial variants
success_rule: Full Lightning must beat additive memory on at least 3/4 primary design-selection metrics, show positive top-5% enrichment, and the shuffled-label control must collapse.
